bayts.text: My gratitude is for a Generous Lord who is ever-Grateful (Shakkār), and from Him I hope, in the two abodes, for ever-new and pure favours.
I have written, in gratitude to Him, that through which I hope to be fortunate, grateful and ever mindful of Him (Dhikr).
I turned my face, in the month of the Prophet, my support, to the Most Generous, the Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), the Bestower, in gratitude.
I hoped from Him, the Most High, that He would accept my work with gratitude and raise me today; what an excellent Forgiver!
I hoped that He would efface from me all my slips in their entirety, and subject to me the unbelievers forever.
Truly I address Him in the midst of the sea, in exile, and He, majestic is He, never ceases to be the Subduer (Qahhār) and the Compeller who restores (Jabbār).
You surprised me, O Lord, with blessings; grant me that I return to dry land, and subdue for me whoever contends with me.
Send blessings and peace upon the Prophet, with the noble ones, and raise me, and increase me, after the raising, with ever-new gifts.
